title: MambaLRP: Explaining Selective State Space Sequence Models

layout.note: Three panels in a row separated by thick black vertical rules; a) is a small network with a formula under it; b) and c) have the same layout: title with a long left arrow, two blocks, a tag under the first block, a curved arrow to a photo-and-heatmap pair at the bottom.

lesson: Draw the same blocks twice, before and after the method, and print the quantity that should be conserved at every boundary; equal against unequal numbers make the fix visible at a glance, and a photo and heatmap pair closes each lane.
